title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment Between Human and LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating human-AI value alignment by comparing LLM generated responses to human survey data across 7 different countries (US, UK, India, Germany, France, Canada, Australia). The framework uses Schwartz's 56 universal basic values and calculates alignment rates (F1 scores) and alignment distances (Manhattan distance) across 4 real-world contextual scenarios.
